items.title: Home
items.text: Home Oltinkul Leather & Footwear Small Industrial Zone, Uzbekistan: retail units from a 20% down payment, 5-year bank financing with a 1-year grace period. For manufacturers, wholesale and retail buyers.

items.title: About
items.text: About The zone brings together the valley’s entrepreneurs, craftsmen and clusters producing leather goods and finished footwear. It is building a complete chain — from processing raw hides to finished products and sales.

items.title: Financing
items.text: Financing You make the down payment, the bank finances the rest. Enter the unit price to see the payment schedule instantly.

items.title: Shops
items.text: Shops Click a unit to see its size, price and monthly payment.

items.text: The President visited the zone’s projects During his trip to the Andijan Region, the President visited the Oltinkul Leather and Footwear Small Industrial Zone and reviewed its projects. Visit

items.text: The zone’s products are reaching foreign markets Goods made in the zone are shipped to Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Afghanistan. Export
